claims.text: Rosacea often coexists w posterior blepharitis
claims.quote: For example, rosacea, a systemic dermatological condition, often coexists with posterior blepharitis and leads to inflammatory changes in both the meibomian glands and the skin.

claims.text: Blepharitis care: daily eyelid hygiene, warm compresses and gentle lid cleaning
claims.quote: Management focuses on daily eyelid hygiene, warm compresses, and gentle lid cleaning.
